为人设单独指定模型后，对话该人设时将自动路由至此模型。: Once a persona has its own model, chats with that persona route to it automatically.
之前未答完的问题，答完后继续: Questions left unanswered earlier — pick up after these.
人设各参数与规则实时生效。: Every setting and rule here takes effect immediately.
仅发送前替换 (不影响本地展示): Replace before sending only (local display unaffected)
从文件导入动图/表情: Import GIFs or stickers from a file
从文件导入（音频/文档/任意）: Import from a file (audio, documents, anything)
以语音气泡发送语音消息: Send a voice message as a voice bubble
任务到点时应用不在前台，就没有任何提醒；打开通知可让兜底提醒恢复。: If the app isn't in the foreground when a task comes due, nothing reminds you. Turn notifications back on to restore the fallback.
你选定了系统音色。切换后朗读用系统声音；随时可在 设置 › 语音服务 切回。: You picked a system voice. Reading aloud will use it from now on; switch back anytime in Settings › Voice Services.
关掉的不再进它的 system prompt。注意：这个开关只管「要不要展示」，: Disabled items stop appearing in its system prompt. Note this only controls what is shown — it is not a security boundary; disabled items can still be read or called directly.
关闭时只用你配置的声音发声: When off, only the voices you configured are used
分组里的服务不受影响，只是解散这个分组。: The services inside keep working — only the grouping is removed.
可以在聊天里直接创建一个。: You can also create one right in a chat.
向用户消息追加当前时间: Append the current time to user messages
向请求体顶层或 extra_body 注入自定义参数字段（例如供应商专用扩展）。: Inject custom fields into the request body or extra_body (for example provider-specific extensions).
回复语言：选「中文 / 英文」后，会作为硬约束写进人设提示（每条都按它回复）；「: Reply language: picking Chinese or English writes it into the persona prompt as a hard rule, so every reply follows it. Auto follows the language you write in.
在 设置 › 语音服务 里调整。: Adjust it in Settings › Voice Services.
在「装扮 → 气泡」里换一张全身立绘: Add a full-body portrait in Appearance → Bubbles
大模型发起网络请求时，会将上述 Header 注入到 HTTP 请求中，例如特定: These headers are injected into every model request — useful for gateway routing tags and the like.
如：撒娇求原谅: e.g. acting cute to be forgiven
定义助手的核心人设、口吻、底线与思考模式。保存后立即同步到大模型对话中。: Defines the assistant's core persona, tone, limits and way of thinking. Applies to the model the moment you save.
将同时删除聊天里引用的这些文件，此操作不可恢复。: The files referenced in chats are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
将随消息一同发送: Will be sent with the message
平时任务收尾会自动低频整理一次；这里可以手动催它跑一趟。: It tidies up occasionally on its own after tasks finish; this runs a pass right now.
开启后只对最近的 N 条消息生效，更早的不动。关掉就是全部。: When on, only the most recent N messages are touched. When off, everything is.
开启后将自动截断更早的历史消息，避免上下文窗口过满并降低 Token 消耗。: When on, older messages are trimmed automatically so the context window doesn't overflow and tokens stay down.
开启后所有已配置的 MCP 服务器均对该人设生效。关闭后可单独勾选可用服务器。: When on, every configured MCP server is available to this persona. When off, pick the ones you want below.
开启后新安装的技能将自动对该人设生效。关闭后可手动勾选白名单。: When on, newly installed skills apply to this persona automatically. When off, choose them from a list.
开启的工具将被注入给模型作为 function call 工具使用。未启用的工具: Enabled tools are handed to the model as function calls. Disabled tools are invisible to it.
影子与启用都会记账：影子记「本来会参考哪几条」，启用记「真的注入了哪几条」；上面: Both modes keep a ledger: shadow records which entries it would have used, on records which were actually injected. Shadow hits above is the total.
影子模式会照常检索、并记录「本来会参考哪几条」给你看，但一条都不会真正使用——攒: Shadow mode still searches and records which entries it would have used, but never applies any of them. Build up comparison data, review it, then switch to On.
